{"reference_answer": "

import pandas as pd
import os

# Load the data
data_cna = pd.read_csv(os.path.join("/workdir", "data_cna.csv"))

# Transpose the data so that columns start from "sample ID" and the remaining columns are names of genes
data_cna_transposed = data_cna.set_index("Hugo_Symbol").transpose().reset_index().rename(columns={"index": "Sample_ID"})

# Display the transposed data
print(data_cna_transposed.head())", "test_cases": "import pandas as pd
data_cna = pd.read_csv('/workdir/data_cna.csv')

assert data_cna_transposed.shape[0] in [data_cna.shape[1] - 1, data_cna.shape[1]], "Row count mismatch after transposition"

assert data_cna_transposed.shape[1] == data_cna.shape[0] + 1, "Column count mismatch after transposition"


assert "Sample_ID" in data_cna_transposed.columns, "'Sample_ID' column missing after transposition"


assert data_cna_transposed.columns[1] == data_cna.iloc[0, 0], "First gene column name mismatch after transposition"


assert data_cna_transposed.iloc[0, 1] == data_cna.iloc[0, 1], "First value mismatch after transposition""}
